source_extracts.quote: Personal tiers $15/$25/$30/$40 per month; business plans $35/$50 per month; month-to-month, no term commitment.

source_extracts.label: siteConfig
source_extracts.quote: 7554 Fredle Drive, Concord Township, OH 44077; Mon–Fri 9–6, Sat 9–2; (440) 709-1946.

source_extracts.label: USPS Premium Forwarding Service Residential fees
source_extracts.quote: Enrollment fees (non-refundable): $26.40 if you enroll online; $28.70 if you enroll at the Post Office. Weekly fees: $29.70 for each week of service. (verified 2026-11-20)

source_extracts.label: USPS standard forwarding rules
source_extracts.quote: Standard mail forwarding lasts 12 months. Periodicals are forwarded free for 60 days if fully prepaid by the sender. Allow at least 7-10 business days for a change of address to take effect. USPS Hold Mail: 3–30 days. (verified 2026-11-20)
